[[Image:Trickery.gif|centre|Trickery Logo]] == Introduction == * Competition: [[Trickery TDM League Season 1]] * Round: Final * Match: [[Dutch Hope]] vs [[Four Kings]] vs [[Justified Ancients of Menace]] vs [[Porn Clan]] * Date: 08-03-2004 == Screenshots == === QFFLDM2 === [[Image:TTDML1_Final_HOPE-4K-JAMS-PORN_QFFLDM2.jpg]]

== Report == Chaos. Pure Chaos. Hope showed their good FFA skills to control the RA for the most part, but 4k and JAMS put up a good fight. At one point it looked like 4K would catch Hope, but it wasn't to be. JAMS finish 2nd as Nih dropped with 12 frags early in the game, and he lost them when he reconnected. Good work by all clans, and nice to see a full turn out for the final game of the season.
